description: This file implements the UserSettingsImplementation class, which manages user settings including reading, writing, and notifying changes. It interacts with a remote store object, handles configuration, registration of notifications, and provides getter/setter methods for various user settings.

classes.name: UserSettingsImplementation
classes.description: Implements user settings management, including configuration, notification registration, value retrieval and updates, and migration state handling.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the user settings with the provided service, sets up remote store object, and registers event handlers.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for user setting changes.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a user setting change event to registered notifications.

methods.name: ValueChanged
methods.description: Handles updates from the remote store and triggers corresponding events.

methods.name: SetUserSettingsValue
methods.description: Sets a user setting value in the remote store.

methods.name: GetUserSettingsValue
methods.description: Retrieves a user setting value from the remote store, falling back to defaults if necessary.

methods.name: GetAudioDescription
methods.description: Gets the current audio description setting.

methods.name: SetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Sets the preferred closed caption service.

methods.name: GetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Gets the preferred closed caption service.

methods.name: SetPrivacyMode
methods.description: Sets the privacy mode, either SHARE or DO_NOT_SHARE.

methods.name: SetLiveWatershed
methods.description: Enables or disables live watershed setting.

methods.name: SetPlaybackWatershed
methods.description: Enables or disables playback watershed setting.

methods.name: SetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Enables or disables blocking not rated content.

methods.name: GetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Gets the block not rated content setting.

methods.name: SetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Enables or disables PIN requirement on purchase.

methods.name: GetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Gets the PIN on purchase setting.

methods.name: SetHighContrast
methods.description: Enables or disables high contrast mode.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceRate
methods.description: Sets the voice guidance rate within allowed bounds.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Enables or disables voice guidance hints.

methods.name: SetContentPin
methods.description: Sets the content PIN, validating it as a 4-digit number.

methods.name: GetMigrationState
methods.description: Checks if a specific setting key requires migration.

methods.name: GetMigrationStates
methods.description: Retrieves migration states for all settings.
